angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 3,868,985 km at 120.52 pc = 0.43 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.2972 +/- 0.0189 mas (same row, RUWE 0.87): 120.52 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 5.561 (5.449 to 5.673) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 3,868,985 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.190 (1.145 to 1.243) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4785 +/- 0.7 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6770761168986617600: teff_gspphot 4785.101 K (16th-84th percentiles 4784.442-4785.7974), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6770761168986617600: teff_gspphot 4785.101 K (16th-84th percentiles 4784.442-4785.7974), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/belel.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.023, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 181342 (pscomppars): spectral type K0 III, from Jenkins et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A.283J/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 181342 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.26 dex, from Johnson et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010PASP..122..701J/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 181342 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 1.17, from Jenkins et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A.283J/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 181342 (pscomppars): age 2 Gyr, from Jenkins et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A.283J/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 181342 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.33 km/s, from Jenkins et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A.283J/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
